source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether slow natural changes in rocks and soil are physical or chemical by checking what natural forces do to the materials.
node_labels: Matter: materials, particles, mixtures and change

intelligence.enrichment: Natural factors can break down and move rocks, soil, and sediments; use the new-substance test to decide whether the change is physical or chemical. Wind, rain, and other natural forces act on rocks, soil, and sediments, causing weathering or erosion that forms smaller materials or moves them. The learner explains slow natural changes by identifying what natural forces do and then using the new-substance test for physical or chemical classification. Slow natural changes in rocks are chemical because they happen over many years.
